summary.headline: H1 FY27 revenue rose 46% YoY to INR 929 crore, with EBITDA margin of 12% and PAT up 35% to INR 79 crore.
summary.overview: Rajesh Power reported H1 FY27 revenue of INR 929 crore (up 46% YoY), EBITDA of INR 112 crore (up 33%, 12% margin) and PAT of INR 79 crore (up 35%, 8.5% margin). Management highlighted first positive operating cash flow and an unexecuted order book of about INR 3,647 crore at 30 September 2026, with INR 450 crore more inflows in October. Growth narrative shifted toward transmission (400 kV, moving to 765 kV), BESS EPC, HKRP smart-grid SCADA/DMS, and new geographies (Odisha, New Zealand). Analysts pressed hard on receivables growth versus revenue and on HKRP's contribution, and management's answers on the receivables bridge were not fully reconciled on the call.

segments.name: Distribution (Gujarat)
segments.commentary: PGVCL order of about INR 800 to 900 crore with 18 to 24 month execution; management sees Gujarat distribution tendering of INR 5,000 to 6,000 crore a year. Distribution is not being bid outside Gujarat currently.

segments.name: Transmission
segments.commentary: RVPNL 132 kV GIS substation order in Jodhpur and OPTCL EPC order of INR 212 crore (June 2026, Odisha). Company executes 400 kV substations and expects to qualify for 765 kV after commissioning its current 400 kV project in a couple of months.

segments.name: HKRP Innovations (JV / associate)
segments.commentary: Contributed lower share of profit in H1 and is H2-weighted. Three SCADA/DMS projects in UGVCL, DGVCL and PGVCL; FY27 target of about INR 150 crore revenue and 20% PAT margin on a standalone basis. No HKRP orders in the company's order book.

segments.name: BESS
segments.commentary: 65 MW / 130 MWh standalone project at Virpur, Gujarat. Company bids only on EPC, not BOT; BESS EPC pipeline about INR 200 to 300 crore. Management says BESS revenue and margin contribution will be marginal in FY27.

segments.name: New Zealand (new subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Wholly owned subsidiary Rajesh Power Services NZ Limited set up; evaluating two or three opportunities in EPC for solar integration. No investment quantum disclosed.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance of about 35% to 40% maintained; management reiterated 40% and that the longer-term growth guidance (4 to 5 years) is unchanged.
EBITDA margin guidance of 11% to 12% and PAT margin of 8% to 9% maintained.
Closing FY27 order book target of about INR 5,000 crore, with about INR 1,200 to 1,300 crore to be executed over the next five months per management.
Management targets positive operating cash flow for full FY27.
HKRP FY27 target of about INR 150 crore revenue and 20% PAT margin on a standalone basis.
capex_capacity: Virpur (Gujarat) 65 MW / 130 MWh standalone BESS project is the company's entry into utility-scale storage; IPO proceeds were referenced as partly funding BESS capex.

Cumulative execution: 17,000+ ring main units, 6,500+ distribution transformers, 11,400 km of LT/HT/11 kV cable, about 35,000 km of MV covered conductor (about 25,000 km under execution), 104 air-insulated substations commissioned (four in H1), 2,700+ km of EHV cable.
H1 FY27 installations: 2,700+ RMUs, 300+ distribution transformers, 905 km cable laid, 10,800 km covered conductor, 157 km EHV cable, 12,000 poles erected.
Management expects to qualify for 765 kV substation bids after commissioning the current 400 kV project in a couple of months; entry into 765 kV not expected in FY27.
Inventory held at INR 100 to 125 crore.
demand_pricing: H1 FY27 fresh order inflows of INR 1,250 crore (analyst cited about INR 1,700 crore for April to November); October inflows about INR 450 crore.
Unexecuted order book about INR 3,647 crore at 30 September 2026, excluding GST; outside Gujarat share rose from about 10% to 12%, targeted at 15% to 20% in two years.
Bid pipeline quoted at INR 3,000 to 4,000 crore; ex-Gujarat pipeline about INR 1,500 crore; current L1 position about INR 100 crore.
Win rate stated at 50% to 60% (above 60% in one answer) across geographies and segments.
Gujarat Wire-Free City Mission targets about 46,000 circuit km of undergrounding by 2030; Odisha government plans about INR 16,000 crore of 765/400/220 kV and underground projects.
SCADA/DMS pan-India opportunity estimated above INR 3,000 crore; states tendering include Maharashtra, Assam, Kerala, UP, Bihar and Uttarakhand.

qa_highlights.question: Is the HKRP profit share H2-heavy and what is the order book contribution from HKRP?
qa_highlights.answer: HKRP is H2-heavy with targeted margins expected by year-end. There are no HKRP orders in the order book; it is 100% parent.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a slowdown or project slippage behind the inventory jump versus H1 FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: No. Management said inventory is only INR 100 to 125 crore and nothing similar is happening.

qa_highlights.question: Are receivables plus retention up more than 100% YoY against 45% revenue growth, and is working capital improving?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited receivables of INR 324 crore versus INR 174 crore, with INR 150 to 200 crore of H1 revenue booked in September. It said the improvement comes from better collections and longer supplier credit. Management did not reconcile the YoY retention jump (INR 8 crore to INR 58 crore) to the analyst's satisfaction.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company's working-capital view consistent with the cash-flow target and H2 expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects better or similar working capital in H2 and targets positive operating cash flow for full FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company disclose quarterly numbers?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said June-month execution figures were already given and it would follow a similar approach through the year; no quarterly P&L was committed.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company still on track for 40% growth and 11% to 12% EBITDA margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, management maintained FY27 guidance of about 40% growth (35% to 40% per analyst) and 11% to 12% EBITDA margin, with PAT of 8% to 9%.

qa_highlights.question: What are the nature and size of transactions with HKRP Innovations, which the annual report lists as purchases of about INR 500 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: HKRP provides GIS mapping and tech support on distribution projects. Management said the higher approved limit avoids repeated AGM approvals as new projects are won.

risks_watch: Receivables (INR 324 crore) and retention (INR 58 crore) rising faster than revenue; watch whether the INR 58 crore retention converts in the current year as management stated.
H2 execution dependency: management needs INR 1,200 to 1,300 crore of execution over five months to support the 40% growth guidance.
HKRP's FY27 target (INR 150 crore revenue, 20% PAT) rests on three Gujarat SCADA/DMS projects; H1 contribution was nil.
Gross margin fell sharply YoY and was offset by employee-cost savings; sustainability of the 11% to 12% EBITDA margin amid import-price volatility is unconfirmed.
Related-party purchases from HKRP Innovations (about INR 500 crore per annual report) and the higher approved limit.
Closing order book target of INR 5,000 crore requires a large H2 inflow step-up versus INR 1,700 crore in the first seven months.
Unquantified New Zealand and data-centre opportunities; BESS revenue contribution described as marginal.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, order momentum and guidance, repeatedly reiterating targets. Less precise and somewhat evasive on working-capital and receivables questions, with several answers deferred and no reconciliation of the YoY retention and receivables jump.
key_quotes: We're maintaining our guidance to whatever we have stated earlier.
The longer-term guidance also remains the same.
We are bidding purely for the EPC model of BESS.
The working capital cycle is becoming more prudent, and we are establishing the higher control on collections.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 11-12% is held against H1 at 12%, but gross margin fell sharply YoY and was offset only by employee-cost savings, and import-price volatility is unresolved, so expansion is not assured.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Virpur 65 MW/130 MWh BESS is under construction and 765 kV bids open after the current 400 kV project is commissioned in about two months, but management says 765 kV entry is not expected in FY27 and no plant or capacity quantum is disclosed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Unexecuted order book of INR 3,647 crore at 30 Sep 2026 plus INR 450 crore October inflows, with 1,200-1,300 crore to execute over five months and H1 revenue up 46% YoY to INR 929 crore.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Capex was not discussed beyond the Virpur BESS project and IPO proceeds partly funding it; no utilisation figure was given to size further expansion.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management maintained rather than raised FY27 growth of about 40% and margin of 11-12%, and the INR 5,000 crore closing order book target needs a large H2 inflow step-up from INR 1,700 crore in the first seven months.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: H2 needs INR 1,200-1,300 crore of execution in five months to support 40% growth, and receivables of INR 324 crore (vs INR 174 crore) plus retention of INR 58 crore (vs INR 8 crore) are rising faster than revenue of 46%.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: BESS EPC pipeline of INR 200-300 crore and the New Zealand subsidiary are being pursued, but management says BESS contribution is marginal in FY27 and NZ has no disclosed quantum.

rows.label: Ex-Gujarat share of order book to 15-20% in two years
rows.why: Outside-Gujarat share rose from about 10% to 12%, with an ex-Gujarat pipeline of about INR 1,500 crore out of a INR 3,000-4,000 crore bid pipeline and a 50-60% stated win rate.

rows.label: HKRP Innovations FY27 profit contribution
rows.why: Target of about INR 150 crore revenue and 20% PAT margin rests on three Gujarat SCADA/DMS projects, H1 contribution was nil, and there are no HKRP orders in the company's own order book.

rows.label: Positive operating cash flow for full FY27
rows.why: Management targets positive operating cash flow for the year (first positive in H1, no quantum given), but the receivables and retention bridge was not reconciled on the call.

tone.note: Management was confident on order momentum, the 40% growth and 11-12% margin guidance, and the 400 kV to 765 kV path, but was defensive and deferred on the receivables and retention jump; analysts pressed hard on receivables versus revenue growth and HKRP's contribution.
